targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('hour', created_at) AS time, percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY elapsed_ms) / 1000.0 AS "медиана", percentile_cont(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY elapsed_ms) / 1000.0 AS "90%" FROM identifications WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND elapsed_ms IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Определений в час: всего, дольше 20 секунд, с ошибкой движка

targets.rawSql: SELECT to_char(date_trunc('hour', created_at), 'DD.MM HH24') AS "час", count(*) AS "всего", count(*) FILTER (WHERE elapsed_ms > 20000) AS "дольше 20 с", count(*) FILTER (WHERE failure_reason = 'engine_error') AS "ошибка движка" FROM identifications WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY date_trunc('hour', created_at) ORDER BY date_trunc('hour', created_at)

panels.title: Отказы iNaturalist (429) в час, по тому, кто получил отказ

targets.rawSql: SELECT to_char(date_trunc('hour', at), 'DD.MM HH24') AS "час", count(*) FILTER (WHERE source = 'identify') AS "определение", count(*) FILTER (WHERE source = 'nearby') AS "рядом", count(*) FILTER (WHERE source = 'site') AS "сайт", count(*) FILTER (WHERE source NOT IN ('identify', 'nearby', 'site')) AS "фоновые задачи" FROM inat_rate_events WHERE $__timeFilter(at) GROUP BY date_trunc('hour', at) ORDER BY date_trunc('hour', at)
